titleAr: نظرة على التسويق: الحملات والاشتراكات والولاء

ar: الحملات اللي بعتها كانت عاملة ايه؟
en: How many newsletter subscribers do I have?
How much store credit is outstanding?

steps: The assistant reads campaigns, newsletter subscribers (masked), recent push broadcasts, affiliates, loyalty and wallet totals with your own permissions
edgeCases: Team member lacking the permission gets no answer about that area: the assistant states who can do it (store owner)
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Provider/outage returns an error: the assistant reports it and does not claim a figure
